description:
FILED s526w2 (Opus, 2026-10-24), Pod-Simple-3.47 board census.  PRE-EXISTING on main b89b6add.  The emitter half was #3260 half 2 (gen_funcall_form asks no prototype for force_user_sub); the CONTEXT half and a harness half remain.

    sub g ($) { print "[@_]\n" }  sub L { return (7,8) }
    &g(L());          # perl [7 8]   PCL [8]        (SILENT WRONG)

    use Test::More tests => 2;  my @x = (1,1,"n");
    &is(@x);                      # perl ok 1 - n   PCL dies "invalid number of arguments: 1"
    sub two { (2,2) }  &is(two(), "m");   # perl ok 2 - m   PCL (pl-is (p-scalar-ctx (pl-two)) "m") -> got 2 expected "m"

Pod-Simple t/lib/helpers.pm: `sub e { Pod::Simple::DumpAsXML->_duo(@_) }` and the tests write `&is( e "...", "..." )`; _duo croaks unless wantarray -> basic.t, chunking.t, heads.t, closeys.t, end_over.t, fcodes_e.t, verbatim.t, verb_fmt.t, fcodes_s.t (XMLOutStream) stop at their first such row.

HALF 1 (context, Pl/PExpr.pm child_context ~5609): the prototype-slot SCALAR_CTX / slurpy LIST_CTX block must not run for a funcall whose node has force_user_sub -- TRIED s526w2 (one condition `&& !$parent_node->{force_user_sub}`): fixes the `&g(L())` row ([7 8]) but NOT the Pod-Simple rows, because then `(pl-is (p-list-ctx (pl-e …)))` hands CL pl-is ONE vector and its fixed lambda list (got expected &optional name) dies.  Not shipped alone: it would turn the croak into a raw arity error.
HALF 2 (harness, cl/pcl-test.lisp + the emitter): an & call to a CL-native sub must SPREAD its flattened argument list (apply over p-flatten-args), or the TAP entry points must take &rest and flatten.  Harness change = the companion `--all --quick` per batch (CLAUDE.md table).
ROWS: Pod-Simple ~9 files (the *PLAN* / *FILE* rows of those files, counted in the census).


=== DONE (s530c) ===
FIXED, both halves.  CONTEXT: `Pl::PExpr::call_prototype` is THE one reading of "the & form ignores the prototype" (undef for a force_user_sub call node), asked by child_context's prototype-slot block and by ExprToCL's argument emission (the #3260 site) -- `&g(L())` with ($) passes [7 8], (\@) / (&) / ($$) take no slot.  SPREAD: an & call with arguments is emitted `(p-amp-spread (NAME ARGS...))` (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp, exported, contract docstring): %p-amp-apply spreads an array / hash / list vector argument through p-flatten-args (cells kept, `$_[N]` still aliases) and applies NAME, so a runtime-native fixed-lambda-list sub (pl-is, pl-ok, ...) gets perl's flat @_ -- `&is(@pair)`, `&is(two(), "m")`, Pod-Simple's `&is( e "...", "..." )`; AUTOLOAD, lexical subs and the copy-back of unseen callees still work (the wrap goes on after _copy_back_args).  The harness (cl/pcl-test.lisp) is NOT touched: its `test-to-scalar` count fallback for prototype-less callers stays.
Guard Pl/t/amp-call-proto-01.t (2 whole-output rows vs perl; both fail on 0fb05a79).  corpus-diff vs 0fb05a79: 5 files differ (local my ref signatures sort) = exactly their `&NAME(...)` sites gaining p-amp-spread and those sites' detector-table entries dropping (the & form asks no prototype, #3260's ruling).  Pod-Simple one-file runs (tree): basic 29/29, chunking 9/9, closeys 1/1, end_over 6/6, fcodes_e 18/18, heads 21/21, verb_fmt 60/60, verbatim 29/29, fcodes_s 56/78 -- the 9 #3859 rows left baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv by edit; fcodes_s's 22 newly RUN failing rows were added with cause #4103 (Text::Wrap drops the last newline; pre-existing, filed).  ir-spec §4.1.
subject: `&NAME(LIST)` still imposes the PROTOTYPE's slot context on its arguments (`sub g ($) {...} &g(L())` passes L's last value, perl passes the whole list) -- and PCL's CL-native Test::More functions cannot take a spread list at all (`&is(@pair)` dies "invalid number of arguments: 1"); Pod-Simple's helper `&is( e "a", "b" )` croaks "_duo is useful only in list context" in 9 test files
